name: hou_mcp_spatial_debug
description: Display spatial debug info for a single asset: Asset Name, BBox (x/y/z), Footprint, Placement Radius, Zone, Position, Collision Status. Useful for diagnosing placement issues with real-world assets.
python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.assembly.bounding_box_extractor import get_bbox_extractor
from src.runtime.assets.assembly.collision_detector import get_collision_detector
from src.runtime.assets.assembly.spatial_metadata import SpatialMetadata
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Spatial_Debug(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_spatial_debug"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("asset_json",    "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("position_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="[0,0,0]")
        self.add_input("zone",          "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("scene_json",    "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_output("debug_report_json", "string")
        self.add_output("has_collision",     "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        asset_json    = str(inputs.get("asset_json", "{}") or "{}")
        position_json = str(inputs.get("position_json", "[0,0,0]") or "[0,0,0]")
        zone          = str(inputs.get("zone") or "")
        scene_json    = str(inputs.get("scene_json", "[]") or "[]")

        try:
            asset    = json.loads(asset_json) if asset_json.strip() else {}
            position = tuple(json.loads(position_json))
            scene    = json.loads(scene_json) if scene_json.strip() else []
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Failed to parse inputs: {exc}")
            return {"debug_report_json": "{}", "has_collision": False, "exec_out": True}

        try:
            meta = get_bbox_extractor().build_spatial_metadata(asset)

            # Build scene placements for collision check
            placed = []
            for item in scene:
                s_meta = SpatialMetadata.from_dict(item.get("spatial_metadata") or {})
                s_pos  = tuple(item.get("position", [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]))
                placed.append((s_pos, s_meta))

            col_check    = get_collision_detector().validate_position(position, meta, placed)
            has_collision = not col_check["valid"]

            report = {
                "asset_name":       meta.asset_id or asset.get("name", "?"),
                "bbox":             f"{meta.bbox_x:.2f} x {meta.bbox_y:.2f} x {meta.bbox_z:.2f} m",
                "footprint_area":   f"{meta.footprint_area:.2f} m²",
                "placement_radius": f"{meta.placement_radius:.2f} m",
                "placement_type":   meta.placement_type,
                "anchor_capable":   meta.anchor_capable,
                "walkable_obstacle": meta.walkable_obstacle,
                "zone":             zone,
                "position":         list(position),
                "collision_status": "COLLISION" if has_collision else "OK",
                "collides_with":    col_check.get("collisions", []),
            }

            # Log the debug info
            sep = "-" * 40
            self.log_info(sep)
            self.log_info(f"Asset:    {report['asset_name']}")
            self.log_info(f"BBox:     {report['bbox']}")
            self.log_info(f"Footprint:{report['footprint_area']}")
            self.log_info(f"Radius:   {report['placement_radius']}")
            self.log_info(f"Type:     {report['placement_type']}")
            self.log_info(f"Zone:     {report['zone']}")
            self.log_info(f"Position: {report['position']}")
            self.log_info(f"Status:   {report['collision_status']}")
            if has_collision:
                self.log_warning(f"Collides with: {report['collides_with']}")
            self.log_info(sep)

            return {
                "debug_report_json": json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "has_collision":     has_collision,
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Spatial debug failed: {exc}")
            return {"debug_report_json": "{}", "has_collision": False, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Spatial_Debug
